# TableView.dev

> 100% private, in-browser real estate and lending underwriting suite. Institutional DSCR, cap rate, BRRRR, fix-and-flip, IRC §1031 exchange, and commercial debt models that run entirely in the browser. Zero server uploads, zero data egress, zero paywalls.

## Overview
TableView.dev is a free underwriting workbench for real estate investors, mortgage brokers, acquisitions analysts, and private lenders. Every model - amortization schedules, DSCR qualification tiers, IRC §1031 gain and boot math, commercial balloon balances - executes inside the visitor's browser tab. No deal figures, loan amounts, property addresses, or client financials are ever transmitted to a server.

## Real Estate & Lending Calculators
- [Underwriting Hub](https://tableview.dev/finance-calculator): Entry point to every real estate and lending model.
- [DSCR Loan Calculator](https://tableview.dev/dscr-loan-calculator): Debt Service Coverage Ratio underwriting, maximum qualifying loan sizing, and qualification tier analysis for rental and commercial property.
- [Rental Property Cash Flow & Cap Rate Calculator](https://tableview.dev/cap-rate-calculator): NOI, cap rate, cash-on-cash return, the 1% rule, and a 10-year wealth projection.
- [BRRRR Calculator](https://tableview.dev/brrrr-calculator): Buy, Rehab, Rent, Refinance modeling including cash left in the deal and infinite-return detection.
- [Hard Money & Fix-and-Flip Calculator](https://tableview.dev/hard-money-calculator): 70% rule Maximum Allowable Offer (MAO), points, interest-only holding costs, and net flip ROI.
- [Commercial Loan & Balloon Calculator](https://tableview.dev/commercial-loan-calculator): Commercial mortgage modeling with 5/7/10-year balloon maturity balances and 20-30 year amortization.
- [IRC §1031 Exchange Calculator](https://tableview.dev/section-1031-exchange-calculator): Like-kind tax-deferred exchange modeling, cash and mortgage boot, deferred gain, and replacement basis.
- [1031 Deadline Calculator](https://tableview.dev/1031-exchange-timeline-calculator): Statutory 45-day identification and 180-day closing deadlines.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://tableview.dev/mortgage-calculator): PITI, PMI cancellation, property tax, insurance, HOA, and full amortization schedules.
- [Refinance Break-Even Calculator](https://tableview.dev/refinance-calculator): Net break-even months, cash-out capacity, and the 30-year reset-clock warning.
- [Cash-Out Refinance Calculator](https://tableview.dev/cash-out-refinance-calculator): Borrowing capacity, closing cost break-even, and net cash in hand.
- [Amortization Schedule Calculator](https://tableview.dev/amortization-schedule-calculator): Monthly and annual principal/interest breakdown with extra-payment modeling.
- [Early Mortgage Payoff Calculator](https://tableview.dev/mortgage-payoff-calculator): Interest and time saved from extra monthly or lump-sum principal payments.
- [Loan Comparison Calculator](https://tableview.dev/loan-comparison-calculator): Side-by-side loan analysis and discount-point break-even.
- [Balloon Payment Calculator](https://tableview.dev/balloon-payment-calculator): Remaining balance at maturity for commercial mortgages.
- [Salary to Hourly Calculator](https://tableview.dev/salary-to-hourly-calculator): 2,080-hour annual compensation conversion with FLSA overtime rules.

## Privacy Guarantees
- Zero server storage: every calculation runs in browser memory.
- Air-gapped ready: models keep working with the network disconnected.
- Export formats: Excel (.xlsx), CSV, and print-ready lender dossiers.
